caption:
Many apps keep access you gave them long ago. 📱

Open your phone's privacy or permission settings and review: location, microphone, camera, contacts.
If an app doesn't need it, switch it off.

Follow @techmendly for a new tech tip every day.

#cybersecurity #onlinesafety #privacy #smartphone #android #iphone #appsecurity #techtips #digitalsafety #techmendly

scenes.text: Which apps can hear you right now?
scenes.say: Which apps can hear you right now? You can check in two minutes.

scenes.label: permissions worth checking: location, mic, camera, contacts
scenes.say: Four permissions are worth checking. Location, microphone, camera, and contacts.

scenes.title: Review app permissions
items: Switch off apps that don't need it
scenes.say: Open your phone's privacy settings. Pick a permission, like microphone. Then switch off any app that does not need it.

scenes.myth: If I allowed it once, I have to keep it.
scenes.fact: You can change any permission at any time.
scenes.say: Myth. If I allowed it once, I must keep it. Fact. You can change any permission at any time.

scenes.title: Does it need this to work?
scenes.body: A flashlight app does not need your contacts.
scenes.say: Rule of thumb. Ask, does it need this to work? A flashlight app does not need your contacts.
